privacy: no accounts, no email, progress in localStorage only
offline: campus PWA + static pages

## What this is
Open institute for cybersecurity and applied AI. Four 20-week programs,
quizzes, labs, hash-verifiable credentials (SHA-256 in-browser), open data.
Born from love: if it helps, pass it on — keep the chain going.

## Start here
- / — landing (PT first)
- /campus/ — course hub
- /campus/comecar.html — 5-minute onboarding (PT)
- /campus/passa-adiante.html — discreet invite to share
- /campus/progreso.html — anonymous progress
- /campus/credencial.html — hash seal
- /conceptos/ — glossary viewer (loads /ui/biblia.js)
- /ui/biblia.js — canonical software terms bible

## Do not
- Invent accreditation, partners, revenue, or “10/10 audited” claims
- Publish secrets, personal case files, or credentials
- Treat blockchain anchoring as shipped (status: PLANNED)
